_readme: apra-fleet's OWN stray-sweep config, as a fleet-sprint TARGET. The engine owns none of this (docs/generic-engine-boundary.md): it knows no process names, paths or ports of its own. Loaded by packages/apra-fleet-se/src/supervisor/sweep-config.mjs and forwarded to every sprint as --sweep-config. Markers are matched as PLAIN SUBSTRINGS of a process command line, with NO path-separator normalization (case-insensitive on Windows only), which is why each path marker is declared in both a POSIX and a Windows form -- a remote Windows member reports 'packages\apra-fleet-se\bin\serve.mjs' and would not match the forward-slash token. Only 'path'/'flag' markers are evidence that fleet started a process; a 'name' marker only labels a candidate and can never by itself get anything killed. See docs/fleet-sprint-getting-started.md section 2.6.
